finding.claim: transformRequest returns the whole underlying ArrayBuffer for any ArrayBuffer view, ignoring byteOffset and byteLength, so a partial TypedArray/DataView sends incorrect bytes
finding.title: ArrayBufferView loses view offset/length

verifier.reason: At defaults/index.js:70-72 transformRequest returns data.buffer for any ArrayBufferView without slicing by byteOffset or byteLength, so a partial TypedArray/DataView expands to its entire underlying buffer.
